Why Application Forms Are Game-Changers

Application forms are the fastest way to get on a brand's radar. Here's why they're superior to cold emails:

  • Direct Access: No need to hunt for creator-partnership email addresses or guess the right contact person
  • Streamlined Process: Brands have designed these forms to capture exactly what they need
  • Level Playing Field: Everyone uses the same application format, so your professionalism and niche alignment shine
  • Response Tracking: Many forms send automated confirmations, so you know your application was received
  • Time Savings: Fill out a form in 5 minutes vs. researching contacts and crafting personalized emails

Join Newcollab to browse 3,000+ brands with their creator application forms or verified creator-partnership emails in one place.

The Directory: UGC Creator Application Links (By Category)

We've organized 30+ brands with open application forms by category to make your search easier. Each entry includes the direct link to their application form. Bookmark this page and start applying! For companies that send gifted packages directly and Australian brands with gifting lists, see our dedicated guides.

Beauty & Skincare

This niche relies on authentic reviews. These brands have streamlined systems for reviewing creators.

  • Tower 28 Beauty: Runs the 'Clean Beauty Summer School' creator program.
  • Supergoop!: 'Sunshine Crew' ambassador program for SPF lovers.
  • Glow Recipe: 'Official Glow Gang' ambassador program (applications are often seasonal).
  • First Aid Beauty (FAB): Straightforward affiliate program application.
  • Saie Beauty: Affiliate program is on Share-A-Sale, a major network.
  • Fable & Mane: Official affiliate program for their haircare products.
  • Fenty Beauty: Affiliate program managed through various networks like UpPromote.
  • Drunk Elephant: Ambassador program with seasonal application windows; check their website.
  • The Ordinary: Affiliate program through parent company Deciem, ideal for ingredient-focused content.

Most creators get ignored on application forms — brands receive hundreds per week. A personalised pitch email with your media kit attached gets read first. newcollab writes the email and attaches your kit automatically.

Start pitching brands free →

Fashion & Apparel

From fast fashion to iconic staples, these brands are always looking for new style creators.

  • Princess Polly: Famous for their extensive college and creator ambassador programs.
  • Shein: The #SHEINfluencer program is one of the largest and most accessible.
  • Levi's: Affiliate program managed through networks like Impact Radius.
  • ASOS: Runs affiliate programs on multiple networks like Sovrn. Their 'Insider' program is more selective.
  • Gymshark: No open application, but they state they scout talent. Your best bet is to build your brand and get noticed.
  • Madewell: Affiliate program run through CJ Affiliate, perfect for lifestyle creators.
  • Lululemon: Ambassador program with specific criteria, built for yoga and wellness creators.
  • Revolve: Influencer program with an application process for luxury lifestyle content.
  • Urban Outfitters: Affiliate program with an application, suited to boho and street-style content.
  • Free People: Ambassador program with seasonal applications; check their website.

Tech & Gaming

For streamers and tech reviewers, these brands offer affiliate programs to get you started.

  • Logitech G: A must-have affiliate program for any gaming or tech creator.
  • Razer: Tiered affiliate program for gaming creators.
  • Secretlab: High-converting affiliate program for their famous gaming chairs.
  • NordVPN: One of the largest sponsors on YouTube, with a very active affiliate program.
  • Squarespace: Great for creative professionals and business-focused creators.
  • Corsair: Affiliate program application, a good fit for PC building and setup content.
  • HyperX: Gaming ambassador program for esports and streaming creators.
  • SteelSeries: Gaming affiliate program focused on peripherals; apply via their website.

Want this matched to your niche automatically? Start free on Newcollab →

Food, Drink & Wellness

Ideal for foodies, fitness creators, and wellness advocates.

  • HelloFresh: A dedicated influencer program for creators of all sizes.
  • AG1 (Athletic Greens): High-paying affiliate program for health & wellness creators.
  • G FUEL: A famous ambassador program for gaming and lifestyle creators.
  • Daily Harvest: Affiliate program on ShareASale for health-focused creators.

Application Types Explained

Understanding the difference between gifting, affiliate, and ambassador programs helps you choose the right opportunities:

Program TypeWhat You GetBest For
Gifting ProgramsGifted products in exchange for contentCreators who want free products to review
Affiliate ProgramsCommission-based earnings (% of sales)Creators who drive sales through their links
Ambassador ProgramsLong-term partnerships with products + commissions + feesCreators seeking ongoing brand relationships

Many brands offer combinations of these programs. Your best strategy is to apply to multiple program types from the same brand if they allow it.

Pro Tips for Applying

Treat every application form like a mini-pitch. Don't just fill in the blanks. Use the 'About Me' or 'Why do you want to work with us?' sections to show your personality and your high engagement. Here's how to maximize your success:

  • Be Specific: Reference specific products or campaigns you love from the brand. This shows genuine interest.
  • Highlight Your Engagement: If you're a small creator, lead with your engagement rate (e.g., "6% engagement rate") rather than just follower count.
  • Show Your Niche Alignment: Explain exactly why your audience is a perfect fit for their brand.
  • Attach Your Media Kit: If the form allows file uploads, include your media kit. It makes you look professional and makes their job easier.
  • Be Professional: Use proper grammar, complete sentences, and professional language. This is not a DM.
  • Track Your Applications: Keep a spreadsheet of brands you've applied to, dates, and follow-up deadlines.

Remember: Quality over quantity. A well-crafted application to 5 brands is better than 20 rushed applications.

Common Application Mistakes to Avoid

These mistakes get your application deleted before it's even reviewed:

  • Generic Answers: Copy-pasting the same response to every brand. Brands can tell when you haven't personalized your application.
  • Leading with Follower Count Only: If you have under 10k followers, focus on engagement rate and niche instead.
  • No Clear Niche: Being a "lifestyle" creator doesn't help brands understand who you reach. Be specific.
  • Poor Content Quality: Your social media profile is your portfolio. Ensure your last 9 posts are high-quality and on-brand.
  • Missing Contact Information: Make sure your email address and social handles are correct and professional.
  • Giving Up Too Early: If you don't hear back within 2-3 weeks, follow up politely. Many brands have long review processes.

faq.question: What's the difference between an affiliate, ambassador, and gifting (PR) program?
faq.answer: It's a great question, as they overlap. **Gifting (PR)** is often gifted product in exchange for content. **Affiliate** is commission-based (you get a % of sales from your link). **Ambassador** is often a longer-term relationship that includes gifted products, commissions, and sometimes a flat fee.

faq.question: Does applying to these programs guarantee I'll be accepted?
faq.answer: No, it doesn't. Brands receive many applications. Your best chance is to have a professional profile, a high engagement rate, and a clear niche that perfectly matches the brand's target audience.

faq.question: What if a brand I love isn't on this list?
faq.answer: If a brand doesn't have a public application, your best bet is to use our brand pitch email templates to send a professional, cold-outreach email.

faq.question: How is Newcollab different from just applying to these programs?
faq.answer: Each form is one application to one brand. Newcollab puts 3,000+ brands with their creator application forms or verified creator-partnership emails in one directory you can filter by niche and country. On Pro, Polly, our AI agent, also pitches brands for you from your own Gmail and follows up.

faq.question: How long does it take to hear back from application forms?
faq.answer: Response times vary by brand and program type. Gifting applications typically respond within 1-2 weeks, ambassador programs within 2-4 weeks, and affiliate programs within 3-7 days. Always follow up politely if you haven't heard back after 3 weeks.

faq.question: What are UGC creator application forms?
faq.answer: UGC creator application forms are official online application pages where influencers request to join a brand's creator or gifting list. Instead of cold-emailing, you submit your social stats, niche, and content samples through a structured form brands use to review creators.

faq.question: Where can I find brands accepting UGC creators in 2026?
faq.answer: This directory lists 30+ brands with public creator application forms. You can also browse Newcollab's brand directory for application methods, or read our complete brand application guide for step-by-step tips.
